summary.name: Amphetamine
summary.one_liner: Amphetamine is a free macOS keep-awake utility by William Gustafson that stops your Mac and optionally its display from sleeping, either manually or through automatic triggers.
use_cases: keep a Mac awake during downloads or long tasks
keep a MacBook awake with the lid closed
automatically stay awake when an external display or specific app is active
prevent screen lock or screen saver while working
summary.what_it_does: Amphetamine keeps a Mac awake through a simple on/off menu switch or through Triggers that start sessions automatically. Sessions can run indefinitely, for a set duration, until a set time, while a file is downloading, or while a specific app runs. During a session you can allow or block display sleep, screen saver activation, system sleep when the built-in display is closed, mouse cursor movement, and screen locking. Triggers can respond to external displays, USB or Bluetooth devices, power adapter or battery state, Wi-Fi network, IP address, VPN, DNS servers, audio output, mounted volumes, CPU load, and idle time. The app also offers AppleScript support, hot keys, custom menu bar icons, and an optional session countdown in the menu bar.
notable: Automatic Triggers based on devices, networks, power, apps, CPU, and idle time
Closed-display mode keeps a MacBook awake with the lid shut
Power Protect is an optional separate download for Apple Silicon laptops
No ads, no in-app purchases, and no tracking according to the page
caveats: Requires macOS 10.11 or higher per the description, with some features needing newer macOS; the App Store listing says macOS 10.13 or later
Power Protect is not included and must be downloaded separately for closed-display use on Apple Silicon laptops
Mac only; no other platforms named
